indications: Pazopanib tablets are kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adults with: advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC). (1.1) advanced soft tissue sarcoma (STS) who have received prior chemotherapy. (1.2) Limitations of Use : The efficacy of pazopanib tablets for the treatment of patients with adipocytic soft tissue sarcoma or gastrointestinal stromal tumors has not been demonstrated.
contraindications: Recommended Dosage: 800 mg orally once daily without food (at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after a meal). (2.1) Moderate Hepatic Impairment: 200 mg orally once daily. (2.2)
warningsAndPrecautions:
Pazopanib 200 mg tablets are supplied as capsule-shaped, grey colored, film-coated debossed with ‘
 
  S7’ on one side and plain on other side and are available in:

 
                  
                     Bottles of 30 Tablets with child-resistant closure: NDC 63304-116-30
                     Bottles of 120 tablets with child-resistant closure: NDC 63304-116-13
                  
                  Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F); excursions permitted between 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
